data.title: bn-ixh: Packed HTML real-browser verification
data.description: Review the committed browser-smoke harness, opt-in Just gate, failure artifact retention, and provisioning/acceptance docs. Verify trusted pointer input, audio, pause/reset, network/page-error checks, and safe cleanup.

data.body: [P2] Network isolation can false-green. A successful driver envelope without an array at data.requests is silently converted to [], and the filter rejects only http(s), so file:// dependencies and ws/wss/ftp traffic are accepted. That does not establish the bone's absence-of-network/self-contained invariant. Require the expected request-list shape, require the exact pageUrl document request, and reject every request URL other than that document plus explicitly justified data:/blob: internal URLs.

[P2] Frame/canvas verification can false-green on a frozen or non-rendering game. successfulFrames only counts con_step calls, while screenState hashes the raw WASM framebuffer; this code takes only one framebuffer snapshot and never reads rendered canvas pixels. A no-op/stale putImageData path, or an engine whose framebuffer never changes, still passes. Compare framebufferHash across a known animated interval/input (Lantern Leap changes it in the current browser) and validate non-uniform canvas pixels with getImageData so the real-browser gate proves both framebuffer evolution and presentation.

data.reason: Two acceptance assertions can false-green: network isolation silently accepts malformed request data and non-HTTP external/local dependencies, and frame checks do not prove framebuffer evolution or actual canvas presentation.

data.body: Fixed in 8425bcb: the harness now hashes raw framebuffer and rendered canvas before/after the animated interval, and requires a changing, non-uniform 144x256 canvas read via getImageData. Real Chromium browser-check and just check pass.

Fixed in 8425bcb: request-list shape is mandatory, the exact file document must appear with status 200, and every URL outside that document or an explicit data:/blob: in-memory module is rejected. Real Chromium browser-check passes.
